        At the very outset, I on behalf of the college family hearty welcome all the students
who are going to take admission into the various programmes of Joya Gogoi College,
Khumtai. Our country has already implemented NEP 2020, where the course has been
structured in the best possible way for the betterment of students. I wish, the generous
sharing and cooperation from all the stakeholders of this institution to make Joya Gogoi
College as an educational hub in this rural locality, district and state as a whole. In this
context, I take the opportunity to write a few words towards introducing the college.

        We are always keen to well acknowledge the contributions of Late Jiba Kanta Gogoi,
his loving family and some other distinguished persons of greater Khumtai locality. The
great soul late Jiba Kanta Gogoi, the then Finance Minister of Assam was the pioneer donor
and contributor of the college who helped in taking shape of the college in a diverse way.

          Joya Gogoi College is a premier higher education institution located at Khumtai,
in Golaghat district, having rich cultural heritage and glorious educational background. The
college has celebrated its Silver Jubilee in the year 2016. Since its very inception from 1991,
the college has been imparting quality education, mostly to the rural socio-economic weak
students of Khumtai & adjoining areas. However, to satisfy the multifaceted educational
needs of rural students, the college has been organising different short term career
programmes. In recent years, the community development programmes and extension
activities of this college earned a new momentum, only because of the faculties and staff
members’ sincere devotion to their respective duties.

       ➢ About the College
     Joya Gogoi College was established on the 25th of November 1991 and is situated about 20
  K.M. away from heart of the Golaghat town. Eminent scholar and litterateur, Ex- finance
  minister and former speaker of the Assam Legislative Assembly late Jiba Kanta Gogoi was the
  founder of this educational institution. The college was named in the glorious memory of his
  mother late Joya Gogoi. From its modest inception as an Arts college, Joya Gogoi College has
  now developed into its present stature of a famous full-fledged Degree College, imparting higher
  education in the Arts stream and recently introducing science stream in both H.S. and degree
  standard.
        1. Mission:
❖ To provide affordable quality education by bringing innovation in learning methods and
  adopting diversified curriculum to develop good, thoughtful, well-rounded graduates with
  knowledge and skills and prepare the youth ready to face the challenges of future,
❖ To make intellectually aware & socially responsible citizen.
❖ To observe and analyze the performance standard of the faculty members through self-
  assessment and feedback mechanisms.
❖ To organize various academic activities such as seminars, workshops, educational field tour
  etc. for quality enhancement of students and the faculties.
        2. Vision:
The vision of Joya Gogoi College is to develop an education system deep rooted in Indian ethos
with a goal of transforming the locality into an equitable and vibrant knowledge society by
imparting high quality education for all.
        3. College Campus:
The college has a clean, beautiful and suitable academic atmosphere having three campuses i.e.
A, B & C. The existing Campuses A & B are situated at the heart of Khumtai and by both sides
of historic Dhodar Ali. Another campus C is half kilometer away from the A & B Campus of the
College. The Campus A is allotted for the major class rooms, the museum, the Office for the
Career Guidance and counseling Cell, the Office for the Alumni Association and Guardians
Association. The Administrative Block, class rooms, Library, Auditorium, Teachers’ Common
Room, the Girls’ hostel (construction is going on) and Canteen etc. are conveniently located in
the campus B and campus C is allotted for playground and indoor stadium.

         4.Course Structure
About Dibrugarh University Regulations for the Four-Year Undergraduate Programme
(FYUGP) In Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) from the Academic Session, 2023-2024

  Based on the new curricular framework as envisaged under the New Education Policy, 2020 by
University Grants Commission (UGC) on the Choice Based Credit System (CBCS); Dibrugarh
University designed the Four-Year Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP) to provide multidisciplinary
and holistic education, student centric, flexible choice based credit system with multiple entries/exits
options to obtain a Certificate or a Diploma or Degree with or without Major or a Degree (Honours) or
a Degree (Honours) with Research at various levels as stipulated under the policy. This is called
Dibrugarh University Regulation for the Four-Year Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP) and it is
applicable for all the affiliated/permitted College of Dibrugarh University.

     Undergraduate Programme will include the following:

1. UG Certificate Programme: Students shall be awarded UG certificate in the Field of
   Study/Discipline after completing 1 year (both 1 st and 2nd Semester) with requisite 44 credits on
   completion of 2nd Semester. In addition to this they have to complete one work based/skill based
   vocational course/internship of 4 credits within one year from the completion of 2 nd semester
   examination.

2.   UG Diploma Programme: Students shall be awarded UG Diploma in the Field of
     Study/Discipline after securing the requisite 88 credits on completion of 2 years (4 semesters). In
     addition to this they have to complete one work based/ skill based vocational course/internship of
     4 credits one year from the completion of 4 th semester examination.

3.   Three Year UG Degree Programme (BA, B. Sc, B. Com and Bachelors in other disciplines)
     with single/double major: Students who wish to undergo a 3-year (6 semester) UG programme
     shall be awarded UG degree in the Major discipline after successful completion of three years,
     securing a minimum of 132 credits. Provision of double Major shall be implemented in due course
     of time.

4. Four Year UG Programme with honours (BA, B. Sc., B. Com and Bachelors in other
   disciplines) with single/double major: Students who wish to undergo a 4-year (8 semester) UG
   Programme shall be awarded UG Honours degree in the Major discipline after successful
   completion of four years, securing a minimum of 176 credits. Provision of double Major shall be
   implemented in due course of time.
5. Four Year UG Programme with honours with Research (BA, B. Sc, B. Com and Bachelors
   in other disciplines) with single/double major: Students who wish to undergo a 4-year (8
   semester) UG Programme shall be awarded UG Honours and research degree in the Major
   discipline after successful completion of four years with a rigorous research project, securing a
   minimum of 176 credits. Provision of double Major shall be implemented in due course of time.
FYUGP of Dibrugarh University has the following provisions:
   1. Multiple Exits and Entries: FYUGP allows the students to have multiple exits and entries i.e.
       a student can exit the programme, say after one year and then again can enter the programme
       at a later time and can continue the programme from where he/she left if they fulfil the
       minimum eligibility criteria as given in Dibrugarh University Regulation.




                                                   6
     2.   Academic Bank of Credits (ABC): As per the Dibrugarh University Regulation for FYUGP,
         all the credits of a student earn at the end of an examination will be deposited in the ABC
         account where the students have to register through ABC portal as notified by the University.

            The entire Dibrugarh University FYUGP curriculum has the following categories of courses:

       1. Major Discipline
            • Major Course (Core)
       2. Minor Discipline
       3. Multidisciplinary Generic Elective Courses (GEC)
       4. Ability Enhancement Courses (AEC)
       5. Value Added Courses (VAC)
       6. Skill Enhancement Courses (SEC)
       7. Community Engagement
       8. Field based learning/Project
       9. Internship
       10. Research Project/Dissertation
       As per the availability of the courses in our college student can choose their courses like SEC,
GEC etc. within 10 days of admission based on their interest.

         Course Enrolment:
         Change in Major: Students shall be allowed to change major within the broad discipline at the
end of the second semester by giving him/her sufficient time to explore interdisciplinary courses during
the first year.

       Change in Minor: Students shall be allowed to change Minor courses of his/her areas of interest
within the broad discipline at the end of the third semester

        Attendance: A student should have at least 80% of attendance during the total number of class
days. A student who has less than 80% attendance in average shall not be permitted to sit for the End
Semester Examination.

       Betterment Examination: A student shall be entitled to take the Betterment Examination in
any two theory courses after successful completion of 3 year/ 4 year programme only once. No
betterment shall be allowed in the practical/project/dissertation/internship examination.

      ➢ FACILITIES FOR STUDENTS:

       1. Capt. Jintu Gogoi Vir Chakra Library:
        The Captain Jintu Gogoi, Vir Chakra Library is the central Library of Joya Gogoi
College, Khumtai established in the year 1992. The library has been named as ‘Capt. Jintu
Gogoi, Vir Chakra Library’ as a mark of respect to the Kargil Martyr Capt. Jintu Gogoi in
the year 2004. The library has a collection of 16,250 books including both university
prescribed textbooks and a good number of reference books on each subject. Besides the
subject-oriented reference books on each as World Classic Books, General and Subject
Encyclopedia, Yearbooks, Atlas, Dictionaries, Books on woman related issues, books on
different issues of North-east India, collection of award-winning books of Sahitya
Akademie, books on performing Art, Career guidance, Computer Science etc.
        The library has 20 journals/ periodical and 6 newspapers. Out of 20 periodicals, 7
are peer-reviewed journals, one discussing journal on International Relation and foreign
policy. The library is also registered under the N-LIST consortium which provides access
to 6000+ electronic journals and lots of e-books of world-class publishers. Besides the
day-to-day activities, the library also provides the following services:
    1. Book Bank Services.
    2. Reprographic Services
    3. Current Awareness Service
    4. Counseling Services
    5. Newspaper Clipping Services
      The library provides “Late Priya Baruah & Late Girish Bora Memorial Best Reader
Award” from the session 2003-04 And also provide “Late Romon Gogoi memorial best E-
resource user award” from the session 2021-22 to one student for each academic session
to inculcate the reading habit among the students.




       2. College Teachers’ Unit Aid Fund:
The Teachers’ Unit of the college extends a provision for students namely “Aid Fund to
the meritorious students” who are seeking admission into different classes of the college.
The facilities of this aid fund are available to those meritorious students who are not
getting scholarships from any other sources.

        3. National Service Scheme (NSS):
        It is an important organization of the College functioning for past many years. The
members of the NSS of this College render various benevolent services in the neighboring
areas of the sub division. It unfolds the opportunities to the students to inculcate the spirit
of fellow-feeling, friendliness and cooperation and service to the downtrodden people for
their socioeconomic upliftment.

       4. National Cadet Corps (NCC):
       Under 12 ASSAM (I) COY, Joya Gogoi College has a fully functional sub-unit, with
50 (Boys) strength.
Prerequisites for joining NCC, JGC:
    1. Student of Joya Gogoi College
    2. Disciple and ready to Volunteer in various events conducted by the Unit
    3. Have to clear Physical and mental test
Duties:
    1. Have to attend all the classes and training conducted by the unit.
    2. Must volunteer in various events conducted by the Unit.
       Have to attain training camps in various parts of country abroad




       5. Xerox Facility
   The college authority offers Xerox facilities for every student at a very nominal rate.
       6. Remedial Classes
In addition to the general classes, the college also provides the remedial coaching classes after
the end of general routine classes each day. No additional fees will be charged for remedial
classes. For details, contact at Principal’s Office.

        7. Games, Sports, Music and Dramatics:
        The College provides adequate facilities for games, music and dramatically activities
for both boys and girls. Regular practice and competition are held under the supervision of
experienced teachers and students showing proficiency are encouraged to take part in the
inter college competitions organized at various level.
        We are very much glad to add here that recently we have completed the construction
of our indoor stadium in Campus C which was funded by UGC. Students now can avail the
sports facility in Badminton and Table Tennis in this indoor stadium. These help in overall
physical and mental wellbeing and carrier development of students.




       8.     Gymnasium:
       The college has recently installed as up to date gymnasium block in the campus. It has
been complete with a fund from RUSA (Rastriya Uchchatar Siksha Abhiyyan). About 20
students can practices at a time in this gymnasium.

       9. College Canteen:
       There is a college canteen within the college campus which is run in a free furnished
structure provides by the college and supervised by a committee constituted for the purpose.

     ➢ Measures Against Ragging:
     The University shall issue an order to punish a student found guilty of ragging after
following the procedure, and in the manner prescribed here in under.
 A) The Anti-Ragging Committee of the Institution shall take appropriate decision, in regard
     to punishment or otherwise, depending on the facts of each incident of ragging and

                                             20
    nature and gravity of the incident of ragging established in the recommendations of the
   anti-ragging squad.
B) The anti-ragging committee may, depending on the nature and gravity of the guilt
   established by the anti-ragging squad, award, to those found guilty, one or more of the
   following punishments:
     i. Suspension from Attending Classes and Academic Privileges.
     ii. Withholding/ Withdrawing Scholarship/ Fellowship and other Benefits.
     iii. Debarring from Appearing in any Test/ Examination or other Evaluation Process.
     iv. Withholding results.
     v. Debarring from representing the institution in any Regional, National or
           International Meet, Tournament, Youth Festival, etc.
     vi. Suspension/expulsion from the hostel.
     vii. Cancellation of admission.
     viii. Rustication from the institution for a period ranging from one to four semesters.
     ix. Expulsion from the institution and consequent debarring from admission to any
           other institution for a specified period.
     x. Fine of 10,000 /- (Rupees Ten Thousand only) or with imprisonment up to 6
           months as per the Assam Prohibition of Ragging Act, 1999.
     xi. To undertake patrolling and make surprise visits to places vulnerable to incidents
           of ragging.
